title: Harmonic approximation lemma at scale R₀ (Simon 5.3.1 with scaling)
statement: For every n ≥ 1 and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with the following property. Let R₀ > 0 and let w : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) be Lipschitz with ∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} ‖Dw‖² ≤ R₀ⁿ and |∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} Σ_i ∂_iw·∂_iζ| ≤ δR₀ⁿG for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with tsupport ζ ⊆ B̆_{R₀}(0) and every G ∈ ℝ with ‖Dζ(v)‖ ≤ G for all v (Dw = fderiv ℝ w, ∂_iw = Dw(e_i), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Then there is h : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that: h is C^m on B̆_{R₀}(0) for every m ∈ ℕ; Σ_i iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![e_i, e_i] = 0 for every y ∈ B̆_{R₀}(0); ‖Dh‖² is integrable on B̆_{R₀}(0) with ∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} ‖Dh‖² ≤ R₀ⁿ; and (h − w)² is integrable on B̆_{R₀}(0) with ∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} (h − w)² ≤ εR₀^{n+2}.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (R₀ : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℝ) (Lw : NNReal), 0 < R₀ → LipschitzWith Lw w → ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ‖fderiv ℝ w v‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₀ ^ n → (∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀ → ∀ G : ℝ, (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → |∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ w v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ δ * R₀ ^ n * G) → ∃ h : Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y => ‖fderiv ℝ h y‖ ^ 2) (ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀) ∧ ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ‖fderiv ℝ h y‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₀ ^ n ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y => (h y - w y) ^ 2) (ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀) ∧ ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, (h y - w y) ^ 2 ≤ ε * R₀ ^ (n + 2)
